name: icloudpd
description: An Alpine Linux Docker container for ndbroadbent's iCloud Photos Downloader. I use it for syncing the photo streams of all the iDevices in my house back to my server because it's the only way of backing up multiple devices to a single location. It uses the system keyring to securely store credentials, has HEIC to JPG conversion capability, and can send Telegram, Prowl, Pushover, WebHook, DingTalk, Discord, openhab, IYUU and WeCom notifications. It is recommended to use the keyring to securely store credentials. Please connect to the container and run `sync-icloud.sh --Initialise` command manually to start the process of saving your password to the keyring and Apple sends a confirmation code via text or 2FA code to your device which needs to be entered into the console. You can also run this command from the Unraid console to start the authentication process. `docker exec -it icloudpd sync-icloud.sh --Initialise` Create a `.mounted` file inside `iCloud` folder in the photos directory for the container to start syncing photos. This file MUST be created manually and sync will not start without it.

paths.name: Download Path
paths.description: Where downloaded photos and videos will be stored. A .mounted file must exist inside this folder before syncing will start.

variables.name: Apple ID
variables.description: Apple ID used to access iCloud.

variables.name: Time Zone
variables.description: Sets container timezone. Example: Europe/Amsterdam

variables.name: Internal Download Path
variables.description: Internal destination used by icloudpd. This must match the container side of the Download Path mapping. Required so first-run configuration does not leave download_path blank.

variables.name: Download Interval
variables.description: Seconds between downloads. Valid values: 21600 (6h), 43200 (12h), 86400 (24h), 129600 (36h), 172800 (48h), 604800 (7d). Defaults to 86400 if an invalid value is set.

variables.name: Download Delay
variables.description: Delay first download in minutes (0-60). Use to stagger multiple containers.

variables.name: Folder Structure
variables.description: Folder structure for downloaded files. Use 'none' for a flat structure. Default: {:%Y/%m/%d}

variables.name: Albums With Dates
variables.description: Organize albums into subfolders by date (uses folder_structure). Default: false

variables.name: Libraries With Dates
variables.description: Organize libraries into subfolders by date (uses folder_structure). Default: false

variables.name: Authentication Type
variables.description: Type of authentication on your iCloud account. Use 'MFA' or 'Web' (if no MFA). Default: MFA

variables.name: Notification Days
variables.description: Notify n days before MFA cookie expires. A single notification is sent per day. Default: 7

variables.name: Single Pass
variables.description: Set to true to exit after a single sync instead of looping. If used, set container restart policy to 'no'.

variables.name: Skip Check
variables.description: Skip the check for new files. Recommended for libraries with more than a few thousand photos. Default: false

variables.name: Photo Size
variables.description: Size to download: original, medium, thumb, adjusted, alternative. Can be comma-separated for multiple sizes. Default: original

variables.name: Skip Live Photos
variables.description: Skip downloading Live Photos. Default: false

variables.name: Live Photo Size
variables.description: Live photo size: original, medium, or thumb. Ignored if skip_live_photos is true. Default: original

variables.name: Skip Videos
variables.description: Skip downloading videos. Default: false

variables.name: Recent Only
variables.description: Only download this number of recently added photos. Leave empty to download all.

variables.name: Until Found
variables.description: Download recent photos until n previously downloaded consecutive photos are found. Leave empty to download all.

variables.name: Photo Album
variables.description: Download only from specific album(s). Comma-separated. Use 'all albums' to download all albums.

variables.name: Skip Album
variables.description: Skip specific albums when using photo_album. Example: All Photos,Videos,Screenshots

variables.name: Photo Library
variables.description: Download only from specific shared library/libraries. Comma-separated. Use 'all libraries' to download all.

variables.name: Skip Library
variables.description: Skip specific libraries when using photo_library. Example: PrimarySync

variables.name: Align RAW
variables.description: For assets with RAW and JPEG, treat RAW in specified size: original, alternative, or as-is. Default: as-is

variables.name: File Match Policy
variables.description: Policy to identify and de-duplicate files. Options: name-size-dedup-with-suffix, name-id7. Default: name-size-dedup-with-suffix

variables.name: Convert HEIC to JPEG
variables.description: Convert downloaded HEIC files to JPEG, retaining the original. Default: false

variables.name: JPEG Quality
variables.description: JPEG conversion quality (0-100). Default: 90

variables.name: JPEG Path
variables.description: Custom path for converted JPEGs. Defaults to download path if not set.

variables.name: Auto Delete
variables.description: Scan 'Recently Deleted' folder and delete those files locally. Default: false

variables.name: Delete After Download
variables.description: Move file to Recently Deleted after download. Cannot be combined with auto_delete. Default: false

variables.name: Delete Accompanying Files
variables.description: Delete generated JPG and MOV files that accompany HEICs (live photo MOVs, converted JPEGs). Default: false

variables.name: Delete Empty Directories
variables.description: Delete empty directories after sync. Only runs if folder_structure is not 'none'. Default: false

variables.name: Set Exif DateTime
variables.description: Write DateTimeOriginal EXIF tag from file creation date. Warning: alters local file and causes re-download with dedup suffix. Default: false

variables.name: Keep Unicode
variables.description: Keep unicode characters in file names. Set to false to strip non-ASCII chars. Default: false

variables.name: Live Photo MOV Filename Policy
variables.description: Filename policy for Live Photo MOV files: suffix (adds _HEVC) or original (same name as photo). Default: suffix

variables.name: Sideways Copy Videos
variables.description: Copy or move downloaded videos to a separate directory (video_path). Default: false

variables.name: Sideways Copy Videos Mode
variables.description: How to handle sideways video copy: 'copy' (leave original) or 'move' (requires delete_after_download=true). Default: copy

variables.name: Video Path
variables.description: Destination directory for sideways video copy/move. Required when sideways_copy_videos is true.

variables.name: Nextcloud Upload
variables.description: Enable upload to Nextcloud after download. Default: false

variables.name: Nextcloud URL
variables.description: Nextcloud server URL. Example: https://my.server.local/nextcloud/

variables.name: Nextcloud Username
variables.description: Username of the Nextcloud account to upload to.

variables.name: Nextcloud Password
variables.description: Password for the Nextcloud account.

variables.name: Nextcloud Target Dir
variables.description: Root folder in Nextcloud to place files in. Cannot be the root of the server.

variables.name: Nextcloud Delete
variables.description: Delete file from Nextcloud when removed locally. Requires auto_delete=true. Default: false

variables.name: Notification Type
variables.description: Notification provider to use. Options: Prowl, Pushover, Telegram, Webhook, openhab, Dingtalk, Discord, IYUU, WeCom, Gotify, Bark, msmtp, signal. Leave empty to disable.

variables.name: Notification Title
variables.description: Title used in notifications. Default: boredazfcuk/iCloudPD

variables.name: Download Notifications
variables.description: Send notifications with a summary after file downloads. Default: true

variables.name: Delete Notifications
variables.description: Send notifications with a summary after file deletions. Default: true

variables.name: Startup Notification
variables.description: Send a notification when the container starts. Default: true

variables.name: Silent File Notifications
variables.description: Send low-priority (silent) notifications for file downloads and deletions. Default: false

variables.name: msmtp Host
variables.description: [msmtp] SMTP server hostname.

variables.name: msmtp Port
variables.description: [msmtp] SMTP server port. Normally 465 or 587. Default: 587

variables.name: msmtp Username
variables.description: [msmtp] SMTP login username.

variables.name: msmtp Password
variables.description: [msmtp] SMTP login password.

variables.name: msmtp From Address
variables.description: [msmtp] Sender email address.

variables.name: msmtp TLS
variables.description: [msmtp] Enable TLS encryption: on or off. Default: on

variables.name: msmtp Auth
variables.description: [msmtp] Enable SMTP authentication: on or off. Default: on

variables.name: msmtp Extra Args
variables.description: [msmtp] Optional extra arguments for msmtp. Example: --tls-starttls=off

variables.name: Gotify Server URL
variables.description: [Gotify] Server hostname. Example: server.domain.tld (no port, no protocol). Use gotify_https to toggle HTTPS.

variables.name: Gotify App Token
variables.description: [Gotify] Application token for Gotify.

variables.name: Gotify HTTPS
variables.description: [Gotify] Use HTTPS for Gotify server URL. Default: false (HTTP)

variables.name: Gotify Priority
variables.description: [Gotify] Message priority (0-10). Default: 0

variables.name: Signal Host
variables.description: [Signal] Hostname of the bbernhard/signal-cli-rest-api container.

variables.name: Signal Port
variables.description: [Signal] Port the signal-cli-rest-api container listens on.

variables.name: Signal Number
variables.description: [Signal] Phone number of the Signal device to send from.

variables.name: Signal Recipient
variables.description: [Signal] Recipient phone number for Signal messages.

variables.name: Bark URL
variables.description: Full Bark push URL. For the official server use: api.day.app

variables.name: Pushover Token
variables.description: [Pushover] Application API token.

variables.name: Pushover User Key
variables.description: [Pushover] Pushover user key.

variables.name: Pushover Priority
variables.description: [Pushover] Priority: -1, 0, 1, or 2. Default: 0

variables.name: Pushover Retry
variables.description: [Pushover] Retry interval in seconds (priority 2 only). Default: 60

variables.name: Pushover Expire
variables.description: [Pushover] Notification expiration in seconds (priority 2 only). Default: 3600

variables.name: Pushover Sound
variables.description: [Pushover] Custom notification sound. See https://pushover.net/api#sounds for values.

variables.name: Healthchecks URL
variables.description: [Healthchecks] Full ping URL for Healthchecks.io.

variables.name: Webhook Server
variables.description: [Webhook/openhab] Hostname of the webhook server.

variables.name: Webhook Port
variables.description: [Webhook/openhab] Port for the webhook server. Default: 8123

variables.name: Webhook Path
variables.description: [Webhook/openhab] Path on the webhook server. Must start and end with /. Default: /api/webhook/

variables.name: Webhook ID
variables.description: [Webhook/openhab] Webhook ID. For openhab use 'state'.

variables.name: Webhook HTTPS
variables.description: [Webhook/openhab] Use HTTPS. Default: false (HTTP)

variables.name: Webhook Body
variables.description: [Webhook] Body key for the webhook request. HA=data, Discord=content, IFTTT=value1. Default: data

variables.name: Webhook Insecure
variables.description: [Webhook] Allow insecure HTTPS certificates (e.g. self-signed). Default: false

variables.name: Telegram Token
variables.description: [Telegram] Bot token from BotFather.

variables.name: Telegram Chat ID
variables.description: [Telegram] Chat ID for the bot. Prefix with - for group chats.

variables.name: Telegram Polling
variables.description: [Telegram] Enable polling to allow remote sync/auth via chat messages. Default: false

variables.name: Telegram Silent Notifications
variables.description: [Telegram] Send file download notifications silently. Default: false

variables.name: Telegram Server
variables.description: [Telegram] Proxy server FQDN if Telegram is blocked in your country.

variables.name: Telegram HTTP
variables.description: [Telegram] Use HTTP instead of HTTPS if Telegram is restricted to HTTP only. Default: false

variables.name: Prowl API Key
variables.description: [Prowl] API key from the Prowl website.

variables.name: DingTalk Token
variables.description: [DingTalk] Access token from DingTalk app Security Settings.

variables.name: Discord ID
variables.description: [Discord] First part of the Discord webhook URL (numbers only).

variables.name: Discord Token
variables.description: [Discord] Second part of the Discord webhook URL.

variables.name: IYUU Token
variables.description: Access token for IYUU notifications.

variables.name: Initialise Keyring
variables.description: Run password/keyring setup and create MFA cookie on next start.

variables.name: Convert All HEICs
variables.description: Convert HEICs that do not have a corresponding JPEG.

variables.name: Force Convert All HEICs
variables.description: Convert all HEICs regardless of existing JPEG presence. 2-minute delay before running.

variables.name: Force Convert All HEICs in /mnt
variables.description: Convert all HEICs in /mnt path. 2-minute delay before running.

variables.name: Remove All JPGs
variables.description: Remove all JPEGs that have a matching HEIC source file.

variables.name: Correct JPEG Time Stamps
variables.description: Correct JPEG timestamps to match their accompanying HEIC files.

variables.name: Remove Keyring
variables.description: Delete stored password and keyring data. Use when changing Apple ID password.

variables.name: Enable Debugging
variables.description: Enable verbose debug output.

variables.name: Disable Debugging
variables.description: Disable debug logging.

variables.name: Upload Library to Nextcloud
variables.description: Force upload entire local library to Nextcloud.

variables.name: Sideways Copy All Videos
variables.description: Copy or move all videos in download path to video_path.

variables.name: List Albums
variables.description: List all albums available in the iCloud account.

variables.name: List Libraries
variables.description: List all shared libraries available in the iCloud account.

variables.name: User
variables.description: Container user name (e.g. 'nobody'). Also used as the Telegram remote-sync trigger word.

variables.name: User ID (PUID)
variables.description: User ID to match permissions on host.

variables.name: Group
variables.description: Group name for file permissions.

variables.name: Group ID (PGID)
variables.description: Group ID to match host group.

variables.name: Force GID
variables.description: Allow creation of a group with a pre-existing group ID. Use with caution.

variables.name: Directory Permissions
variables.description: Permissions to set on directories in the download destination. Default: 750

variables.name: File Permissions
variables.description: Permissions to set on downloaded files. Default: 640
